title: Budget repository topology maps and fall back when stale
narrative: Nubble starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Nubble feeds the context compiler a budgeted repository map. When the map is over budget or stale, the system must omit paths honestly and still allow source inspection fallback — not pretend the map is complete.
implementation:
`RepositoryTopologyProvider` builds budgeted `TopologyView` entries with omissions and invalidation; stale maps fall back to source inspection.

Covers: CTX-08.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
